name: Onyx
overview: Onyx is presented in Scripture as a precious stone of significant spiritual and ceremonial value. It was used in the construction of the priestly garments, specifically engraved with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel and set on the shoulders of the ephod as a memorial before the LORD, highlighting its role in representing God's covenant people (Exodus 28:9-12). Additionally, onyx is noted as a valuable resource from the land of Havilah (Genesis 2:12) and was part of the materials contributed by the Israelites for sacred purposes (Exodus 25:7). This precious stone also appears in the foundations of the New Jerusalem in John’s apocalyptic vision, symbolizing the eternal and holy nature of God's kingdom.
